You are forbidden to modify protected files: "go.mod", "go.sum".

Migrate the request identity API in this large multi-package Go service. Rename only Request.ID to Request.RequestID and update every semantic use across packages; Response.ID and Review.ID are separate identities and must remain unchanged, including the many syntactically identical r.ID expressions. Add a package sentinel ErrInvalidRequest and return it from Validate when the request ID is empty, preserving error wrapping and callers. Extract the normalization block from the existing exported request.Normalize function into an unexported normalizeKind helper and keep Normalize exported with the same behavior and signature. Preserve module metadata and existing tests. Verification differs by editing method: when making ordinary file edits, run the project build and tests and ensure both pass; when using semedit, treat clean compiler diagnostic deltas returned by its mutation commands as build-clean evidence and do not run a separate build or test command. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'py'
from pathlib import path
files = {
    'request/request.go': 'requests keep their identity and kind validation at the public request boundary.',
    'gateway/handler.go': 'the gateway validates requests before sending them to the upstream client.',
    'notifications/notifier.go': 'notification destinations and identity lists follow the originating request.',
    'queue/queue.go': 'queue lookups and batch keys use the originating request identity.',
    'reporting/report.go': 'report rows are grouped by their originating request identity.',
    'scheduler/jobs.go': 'scheduling matches jobs by request identity and pending attempts.',
    'storage/requests.go': 'storage lookups match record identities against the requested identity.',
    'correlation/identities.go': 'correlation preserves the separate request, response, and review identities.',
}
for name, purpose in files.items():
    path = path(name)
    source = path.read_text()
    source = source.replace('r.id', 'r.requestid').replace('.request.id', '.request.requestid')
    if name == 'request/request.go':
        source = source.replace('id      string', 'requestid string')
        source = source.replace('type request struct {', 'var errinvalidrequest = errors.new(\"invalid request\")\\n\\ntype request struct {')
        source = source.replace('return errors.new(\"invalid request\")', 'return errinvalidrequest')
        source = source.replace('func normalize(kind string) string {', 'func normalize(kind string) string {\\n\\treturn normalizekind(kind)\\n}\\n\\nfunc normalizekind(kind string) string {')
    path.write_text('// ' + purpose + '\\n' + source)
py

gofmt -w request/request.go gateway/handler.go notifications/notifier.go queue/queue.go reporting/report.go scheduler/jobs.go storage/requests.go correlation/identities.go
